blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The planned blockbuster listing of GCash operator Mynt Inc. could demonstrate the Philippine stock market’s capacity to absorb large equity deals while drawing more retail investors into equities, according to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
